steps.subject: Your Franklin Navigator community profile
steps.body:
Hi {{Outreach_Greeting}},

Franklin Navigator is a local community network that helps Franklin residents find and connect with local businesses, professionals, organizations and resources.

Your Franklin Navigator profile:
{{Profile_URL}}

There is no charge to claim and manage your basic profile.

Optional Community Membership is $35/year, renewing annually until canceled. Membership can help you add more business details, services, hours, photos, website and contact links, booking or quote links where applicable, and additional local visibility and community-participation tools.

Factual corrections and profile-removal requests are always free.

Questions? Just reply and we’ll be happy to help.

notes: Exactly two follow-ups are enabled for the pilot; the prior third follow-up draft is intentionally not enabled to reduce complaint risk.
Follow-ups are never sent after a reply, unsubscribe, bounce, complaint, correction/removal request, organization/domain suppression, or other stop signal.
Mailshake campaign 1553662 remains paused and is not the sending engine.
Owner explicitly authorized the first-10 initial emails to begin immediately outside the normal business-hours window on 2026-09-29; 12-minute spacing remains enforced.
